title: Add fxtwitter/vxtwitter/defuddle extraction backends
description:
# Add fxtwitter/vxtwitter/defuddle extraction backends to scrpr

## Problem
scrpr currently supports extraction backends: readability (local), tavily, jina. X/Twitter URLs are login-gated and fail local + jina extraction (observed: 5 extractor attempts on one tweet). Public X-text APIs (vxtwitter/fxtwitter) return tweet text as clean JSON with no API key.

## Goal
Add three named backends behind `-B`/`--extract-backend`:
- `fxtwitter` / `vxtwitter` — public, no-key. Translate an x.com/twitter.com URL into the fxtwitter API (`https://api.fxtwitter.com/{handle}/status/{id}`), fetch JSON, extract `tweet.text` (and `article.content` for note-tweets). vxtwitter = same service; alias.
- `defuddle` — self-hosted content-extraction proxy (kepano/defuddle). Configurable `defuddle.base_url` (e.g. http://localhost:8890), fetch `{base_url}/{url}` and return content. Public defuddle.com is a web UI, not a clean API — so this backend needs a configured instance.

## Design
- `internal/extractor/fxtwitter.go` — Backend impl; `Name()` returns fxtwitter or vxtwitter (shared impl, alias). `IsAvailable()` true (no key).
- `internal/extractor/defuddle.go` — Backend impl using `cfg.Extraction.Defuddle.BaseURL`.
- Wire into `processURLBackend` switch in `cmd/scrpr/main.go` + `-B` help text ("readability, tavily, jina, fxtwitter, vxtwitter, defuddle").
- Add `Defuddle` config section (`internal/config/config.go`) + example config.
- URL translation: parse x.com/twitter.com/{handle}/status/{id} → api.fxtwitter.com/{handle}/status/{id}.

## Tests
- `internal/extractor/fxtwitter_test.go` — URL translation + JSON parsing (table-driven).
- `go test ./...` green; `just` build/lint.

## Acceptance
`scrpr --extract-backend fxtwitter <x-url>` returns tweet text; `scrpr -B defuddle <url>` works against a configured base_url.

title: Release scrpr v1.1.2 with coherent version stamping and processor fixes
description:
Prepare and publish the first scrpr release after v1.1.1.

Included committed fixes:
- release ldflags can stamp main.version, fixing v1.1.1 artifact incorrectly reporting 1.1.0
- generated TOML schema directives remain valid
- ad-removal no longer deletes article bodies (with regression test)

Release proof:
- working tree contains no unexplained files; .trx/crdt runtime state is intentionally ignored or otherwise resolved before tagging
- gofmt, go vet, and go test ./... pass
- byt release build/checksums dry-run for v1.1.2 succeeds
- built binary reports exactly `scrpr version 1.1.2`
- tag v1.1.2 points at the tested commit and is pushed
- GitHub release has checksums.txt plus all configured amd64/arm64 Linux/macOS artifacts
- downloaded Linux artifact reports 1.1.2
close_reason: Released v1.1.2 from tested commit 012225e. gofmt/vet/tests passed; local byt release build produced four target artifacts; x86_64 Linux artifact reported 1.1.2. Tag pushed, GitHub workflow 30536593950 passed, release contains checksums.txt + four configured artifacts, and downloaded published Linux binary reports scrpr version 1.1.2.
